title: El Ponche de Zitácuaro, MAJESTIC STORIES
comment: ponche-zitacuaro (MAJESTIC): patio de una casa familiar en Zitácuaro, Michoacán, adornado para la Nochebuena. Caras comunes, no famosas; los cuatro se distinguen a simple vista.

chars.GILBERTO_SALGADO: Mexican patriarch from Michoacán, 72 years old, thin but strong, brown wrinkled skin, short white hair, a neat white mustache, a dark-red wool sweater over a white collared shirt, grey trousers, black shoes, his hands empty.
chars.RAMIRO_SALGADO: Mexican man from Michoacán, 38 years old, brown skin, short wavy black hair, a short black beard, a green flannel shirt over a grey t-shirt, jeans, brown boots, his hands empty.
chars.HECTOR_SALGADO: Mexican man, 42 years old, light-brown skin, receding black hair combed back, clean-shaven, glasses with thin metal frames, a navy-blue blazer over a light-blue shirt, beige trousers, brown loafers, his hands empty.
chars.DANIELA_ROBLES: Mexican woman, 38 years old, fair skin, long straight dyed caramel-blonde hair, heavy makeup, big gold hoop earrings, a fitted emerald-green velvet dress, a gold necklace, black heels, her hands empty.

locs.LOC_PATIOZITACUARO: Patio of an old family house in Zitácuaro, Michoacán, on Christmas Eve at dusk: string lights and colorful papel picado overhead, a long dinner table with a white tablecloth, a big clay pot of fruit punch on a small wood fire, poinsettias in pots, adobe walls with arches, warm light, no readable text, no signs, no logos, no people.
